name: jra-bot-web-tools
description: CI・リリース補助・フロントエンドの TypeScript（Gradle 外）。docs/LANGUAGE_MIGRATION.md

scripts.lint: biome check tools dashboard/src/main/ts dashboard/src/test/ts dashboard/run-tests.mjs
scripts.format: biome check --write tools dashboard/src/main/ts dashboard/src/test/ts dashboard/run-tests.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node tools/run-tests.mjs && npm run --silent test:frontend
scripts.preflight: npm run --silent build && node build/tools/src/main.js preflight
